verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is an API-first platform, so it can run headlessly. It offers server-side SDKs for Node.js, Python, Java and .NET, and signing libraries that automate request signing. Calls authenticate with a bearer token plus ECDSA keys, events arrive by webhook, and payments on an authorised mandate execute without further user authorisation, which suits unattended automation. However, nothing in the evidence documents CI or headless workflows directly, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: an official CLI, documented CI/headless or sandbox automation guidance, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.
